tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Additional Format duly filled, sealed & signed
Any other documents in respect of Eligibility criteria and other Terms and conditions of tender.
Authorization letter from Manufacturer in case of Authorized dealer/ Channel Partner/ Distributor etc.
Bidders should provide-1. User Manual,2. Service Manual,3. Spare Parts Catalogue,4. Electrical Drawings,5. Preventive Maintenance Schedule 6. Calibration Certificate-Where Applicable

Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Industries and Commerce Dept in proof of manufacturing status-along with MOA or Annexures/ enclosures to certificate
Declaration-I as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above

Declaration-II as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above-In case the manufacturers/ Principal firm will execute supplies through their Channel Partner/ Authorized Dealer/ Distributor
Declaration-III as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above

In case of Manufacturer, they should submit the Certificate of Incorporation / SSI Certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies / Industries and Commerce Dept / MSME Udyog Aadhaar / NSIC certificate
MSME Certificate / Udyog Aadhar certificate / NSIC certificate / SSI Certificate etc.. Is a proof of manufacturer of tendered items / services.
NSIC certificate-to avail exemption from the payment of Earnest Money Deposit

itemList.itemName: Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) Cleaning Machine & 3 years comprehensive warranty from the date of commissioning (All spares, labour, travel and comsumables (except normal wear items) shall be covered during the warranty period.
